verses.tl: Yusabbihu Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum faminkum kaafirun wa minkum mu'minun Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi wa sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum wa ilayhil-maseer
Ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ya'lamu maa tusirroona wa maa tu'linoona Wallaahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qablu fadhaaqoo wabaala amrihim wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Dhaalika bi-annahu kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faqaaloo abasharun yahdoonanaa fakafaroo wa tawallaw wastaghnaa Allaahu Wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
Za'amal-ladheena kafaroo an lan yub'athoo qul balaa wa rabbee latub'athunna thumma latunabba'uunna bimaa amiltum wa dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseer
Fa-aaminoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wan-nooril-ladhee anzalnaa Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer

Yawma yajma'ukum liyawmil-jam'i dhaalika yawmut-taghaabuni wa man yu'min Billaahi wa ya'mal saalihan yukaffir anhu sayyi'aatihi wa yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari khaalideena feehaa wa bi'sal-maseer
Maa asaaba min museebatin illaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa man yu'min Billaahi yahdi qalbahu Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem
Wa atee'oo Allaaha wa atee'ur-rasoola fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamaa alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna min azwaajikum wa awlaadikum aduwwan lakum fahdharoohum wa in ta'foo wa tasfahoo wa taghfiroo fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Innamaa amwaalukum wa awlaadukum fitnatun Wallaahu indahu ajrun azeem
Fattaqoo Allaaha mas-tata'tum wasma'oo wa atee'oo wa anfiqoo khayran li'nfusikum wa man yooqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
In tuqridoo Allaaha qardan hasanan yudaa'ifhu lakum wa yaghfir lakum Wallaahu shakoorun haleem
